summary: Completed frontend testing of Landing page layout restructure. All 19 test cases PASSED (12 desktop + 7 mobile). Major layout fixes verified: Engine diagram no longer overlaps, max-w-7xl applied, hero grid lg:grid-cols-[1fr_340px], engine hidden on mobile via lg:block, Make in India image capped at max-w-[280px].
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing page layout restructure tested and verified. Key changes from iteration_25: 1) max-w-[1800px] changed to max-w-7xl throughout, 2) Engine CSS: overflow:hidden, canvas height 640px, side labels (.ll/.lr) display:none to prevent text overlap, 3) Hero grid changed to lg:grid-cols-[1fr_340px] for better proportions, 4) Made in India image capped at max-w-[280px], 5) Engine diagram hidden on mobile via lg:block class. All sections verified: Hero (logo, Powered by Bosch, heading, buttons, Make in India image, engine diagram), 4 domain cards, 7-stage build pipeline, 3 pricing tiers, hardware partners, footer links. Mobile responsive layout working correctly with engine hidden and content stacking vertically.
